what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in Finland, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7897 Iraqi refugees in Finland, 2.9% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq from 1993 to 1996 and from 2004 to 2025, with IS, al-Mahdi Army and Ansar al-Islam among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory with the PUK in 1995 and 1996, and an interstate armed conflict with Australia in 2003.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 2244 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 9343, at the end of 2023.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Finland.
These are year-end totals for Finland only, reported to UNHCR.
